The games

Tobu Tobu Girl and Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe are made by Tangram Games. Original music by potato-tan. Game code is MIT licensed and game artwork/assets are licensed CC BY 4.0.

Game images on this site are screenshots captured from the games running in Matchaboy. Gameplay screenshots are fitted into the decorative handheld and screenshot layouts; the handheld’s LCD applies a green tint. Deluxe is shown in original Game Boy compatibility mode. These creators do not endorse Matchaboy.

Read the complete bundled-game credits and license notices.

The app

Matchaboy is an independent open-source project by Vetri1706. Its desktop screenshots and original pixel handheld logo are used from the Matchaboy project, released under GPL v3. Game Boy Advance emulation uses mGBA. Game Boy and Game Boy Advance are trademarks of Nintendo; Matchaboy is not affiliated with Nintendo.

The site

The interactive handheld is an original illustrative 3D model, not a physical product. The circuit-board texture is an AI-generated illustration, not an engineering schematic. The architecture HUD uses illustrative activity, while the app section shows actual Matchaboy captures. Website interactions are not a browser emulator.

3D rendering uses Three.js (MIT license). Scroll animation uses GSAP and ScrollTrigger, under the GSAP standard license. Icons: Phosphor Icons (MIT license). Typography: Bricolage Grotesque and DM Sans, from Google Fonts, under their respective SIL Open Font Licenses.
